language.title: Interface language
language.help: Applies to the interface only. The language of your documents and the detection of personal data are unaffected.

error.network: Cannot reach the server: check that it is running and try again.
error.pii_model_missing: PII model not installed: the folder {{dir}} does not contain config.json. Finish downloading the checkpoint into that folder and try again.
error.session_expired: Your session has expired: please sign in again.
error.wrong_password: Your current password is not correct.
error.password_same: The new password must be different from the current one.
error.password_change_required: You must choose a new password before continuing.
error.delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
error.user_has_no_key: This user has no key yet: create one first.
error.provisioning_key_missing: No OpenRouter management key configured: set it from the API keys page.
error.time_range_invalid: The date range needs both a start and an end.
error.user_key_missing: No OpenRouter key is configured for your account: ask an administrator.
error.queue_full: The processing queue is full: try again in a few minutes.
error.ocr_unavailable: OCR is not available on this server: the rapidocr/onnxruntime packages are not installed.
error.file_busy: This file is already being processed (a column or an OCR re-run): wait for it to finish, or cancel it, before making changes.
error.project_additive_only: Chats in this project have already sent messages: from now on only additive changes are allowed (anonymising more text, sealing areas, uploading new files).
error.project_turn_running: A reply is in progress in one of the project's chats: try again once it finishes.
error.anon_only_categories: Anonymisation categories exist only in anonymised projects.
error.anon_only_realign: Realigning exists only in anonymised projects.
error.anon_only_map_check: Checking against the map exists only in anonymised projects.
error.anon_only_ocr: OCR exists only in anonymised projects.
error.file_already_confirmed: This file is already confirmed: chats may have read it, so it is not rewritten.
error.probe_expired: The prepared file is no longer available: upload it again.
error.format_not_accepted: Accepted formats: PDF, Word (.doc/.docx/.odt), PowerPoint (.ppt/.pptx/.odp), Excel (.xls/.xlsx/.xlsm/.ods), text (.txt/.md/.csv/.tsv/.json/.xml) and images (.png/.jpg/.bmp/.gif/.tiff/.webp, with OCR only).
error.file_gone: That file is no longer on the server.
error.original_gone: The original is no longer on the server.
error.original_gone_reupload: The original is unavailable: upload the file again.
error.column_xlsx_only: Anonymising by column applies to spreadsheets (.xlsx) only.
error.zdr_required: Models without Zero Data Retention are not enabled on this server: an administrator can allow them under Settings (LLM chat section).
error.model_not_allowed: This model is not among those allowed by the administrator: pick another one.
error.mode_locked_project: A project chat uses the project's mode, which cannot be changed.
error.mode_locked_started: The mode of a conversation that has already started cannot be changed: the turns already sent would stay in the context exactly as they left. Start a new conversation instead.
error.anon_required: The administrator has made chat anonymisation mandatory on this server.
error.anon_required_conv_blocked: The administrator has made chat anonymisation mandatory: this plain conversation cannot continue. Start a new one — it will be anonymised.
error.categories_from_project: The anonymisation categories of a project chat are managed from the project: they apply to all its chats and files.
error.categories_turn_running: A reply is in progress in this conversation: the anonymisation categories can be changed once the turn finishes.
error.chat_file_too_large: File too large: the limit for chat attachments is {{max}} MB.
error.attachment_already_sent: An attachment that has been sent stays in the conversation.
error.anon_version_missing: No anonymised version yet: it is created when the message is sent.
error.turn_running: A reply is already in progress in this conversation: stop it or wait.
error.conv_job_running: Something is still processing in this conversation: wait for it to finish.
error.anon_only_preview: The anonymisation preview exists only in anonymised conversations.
error.anon_only_ocr_chat: OCR exists only in anonymised conversations.
error.ocr_running_send: An OCR re-run is in progress on one of this message's attachments: wait for it to finish, or cancel it, before sending.
error.ocr_running_edit: An OCR re-run is in progress on one of this message's attachments: wait for it to finish, or cancel it, before making changes.
error.ocr_attachments_only: The OCR re-run applies to the attachments of the message only.
error.preview_stale: This preview is no longer valid: send again to rebuild it.
error.no_preview: No preview in progress for this conversation.
error.no_preview_resend: No preview in progress for this conversation: send again.
error.no_turn_awaiting: No turn is awaiting confirmation in this conversation.
error.no_live_turn: No turn to replay in this conversation.
error.page_unavailable_preview: Page unavailable: the preview no longer exists (send again).
error.key_not_management: This is a normal inference key, not a Management API Key.
error.setup_done: Configuration already completed: sign in with your credentials.
error.setup_key_missing: Set the OpenRouter management key first.
error.admin_exists: The administrator already exists: continue with the next step.
error.setup_incomplete: Complete the management key and administrator first.
